Chaos!.desc: Let RNG decide your fate, fakes polls from Streamer Polls.

Pure Pandemonium.desc: Pandemonium will replace any node spawn, safe spots are no longer enough.

3AM Challenge.desc: Witching Hour will follow you throughout the run, look at it to scare it off temporarily.

Interloper.desc: Lopee will follow you throughout the run, instantly killing you if it reaches you.

Not For Broadcast.desc: Upon entering the Ridge, a 4 minute and 43 second countdown starts, and will only stop when all have hit the "Voted To End this Madness" button. If the timer reaches zero, you will be killed.

Rat Race.desc: Upon opening the first door, you will be given 50 research, each step costs research, any research collected is shared across players, and is increased by 50%. Taking steps while having no research causes you to take damage.

Noodle Legs.desc: Any damage taken, including from SPR-INTs, will cause you to ragdoll, may softlock you until death if caught in the wrong spot.

Lock In.desc: Dying before door 50 nullifies the bonuses of all modifiers and reduces rewards by 75%.

All Or Nothing.desc: Dying at all nullifies the bonuses of all modifiers and reduces rewards by 75%.
